# Painter Artist

> > Professional and beginner digital painting software with natural media brushes, brush packs, and creative tools for artists on Windows and Mac.

Painter Artist (painterartist.com) is the official home for Corel Painter digital art software, offering professional painting tools, brush customization options, educational resources, and product trials. The site provides comprehensive guides on digital illustration, anime, and manga drawing techniques alongside product information and licensing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Corel Painter 2023
- Digital painting software
- Natural-Media brushes
- ParticleShop Photoshop plugin
- Brush packs
- Digital illustration
- Painter Essentials
- Particle brushes
- Digital art tools
- Wacom tablet integration
- Windows and Mac compatibility
- Education licensing
- Anime and manga drawing
- PSD and TIFF file formats
- Creative software

## Core Products

- [Corel Digital & Photo Painting Software and Painter Apps](https://www.painterartist.com/en): Official Painter homepage with product info, trials, and tutorials.
- [Digital Art & Painting Software - Corel Painter 2023](https://www.painterartist.com/en/product/painter): Corel Painter 2023 main product page with features and pricing.
- [Painting Software for Beginners - Corel Painter Essentials 8](https://www.painterartist.com/en/product/painter-essentials): Painter Essentials 8 beginner software product page.
- [Photoshop brushes – Corel ParticleShop](https://www.painterartist.com/en/product/particleshop): ParticleShop Photoshop brush plugin product page.

- [Brush Packs for Corel ParticleShop – Photoshop Plugin](https://www.painterartist.com/en/product/particleshop/brushes): ParticleShop brush pack add-ons for Photoshop plugin.
